title: [Lean] Bind exact L450 fragment bytes to checked chart payload
body:
## Summary

Bind the exact 907-byte selected L450 fragment to its accepted 73-column compact payload, prove logical UTF-8 recovery, and expose generic original-token uniqueness. Eight unchanged sources total 42,858 bytes, with 30 accepted probes/eight printed type commands and 99 immutable public prerequisites. The full 107-module order is explicit; large predecessor tables are reused, not copied.

## Author-checked context and exact base

κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. The author checked this contextual value and exact README scope. Publication parent: c676548106012571fefa1dce0ec16f1bcfe11dce; selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter continuity is unchanged. This chunk does not improve κ or establish the full multiplication theorem.

## Coverage

Finite/source-bound proof: the exact 907-byte literal equals the typed compact payload of the same 73 bounded columns, retaining selected route lookup, ordered chart and scalar certificate. Conditional interface: logical UTF-8 is proved, while the final validator still requires its explicit logical Json.parse equation. Generic proof: successful checked recovery determines every original quote token and proves serialized key-byte uniqueness. Full-theorem coverage remains open.

The separate one-fragment runtime diagnostic parsed all 73 columns and checked the scalar certificate. Its executable PASS is not a logical parser theorem. The diagnostic source contains #eval; rebuilding that source executes it. Publication preparation reran neither it nor any accepted proof.

## Provenance, reproduction and remaining obligations

ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE.json pins archive/member hashes, emitter path and offsets [142709,143616). These are independently reviewed external provenance, not kernel file-authentication proofs. The logical parser reaches opaque partial definitions. General JSON semantics, runtime extern refinement, file/digest authentication, other fragments, whole-dictionary success, complex phases, physical execution and the full multiplication/runtime bounds remain separate.

Use the prepared-runtime reproduction recipe and immutable manifest. It includes serial resource admission and retained failure logs, plus an optional fresh public dependency build; neither path was executed for publication. Earlier failed attempts remain rejected provenance.

## Reuse and credit

Reuse exact PR1831 route-table reconstruction and PR1879/1927/1950/1961/1978/1993/2016 parser/chart/layout/discovery work. Rohan Arun supplied selected PR1094 source; Jeremy Kothe supplied the T16/PR514 lineage. James Chang with OpenAI assistance. Existing source licenses and attribution are retained. No novelty claim is made for reused prerequisites.

Submission continuity: main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2 retains all five critical selected-source blobs and has no Lean/toolchain/dependency-manifest changes relative to this publication parent. Historical UNCOMPILED preparation comments remain unchanged; ACCEPTANCE.json binds the later successful kernel checks and independent reviews to those exact source hashes.
